The customer has been told its funding status, or the 30-day funding deadline and the opening deposit minimum. They have also been told any fee that applies below the minimum balance, and any feature note that applies: the paperless requirement, Silver terms, the ATM rebate cap, paper statements, and how the card bonus applies.
